mo_ta_cong_viec:
About us: Cloud Ace Vietnam, a premier strategic partner of Google Cloud, delivers end-to-end cloud solutions, from consulting to system development and managed services. With a team of certified GCP experts and a strong presence across Asia, we empower businesses in banking, fintech, Web3, and beyond to achieve digital transformation. Join our innovative, collaborative team to grow your cloud career and make an impact!
Company website:
Head Office: H3 Building, 1st Floor, 384 Hoang Dieu Street, Khanh Hoi Ward, HCMC
Representative Office: 2nd Floor, 25T2, Hoang Dao Thuy Street, Yen Hoa Ward, Hanoi
 
Job Description 
We are looking for a forward-thinking AI Engineer to join our innovative team. In this role, you will leverage the full power of the Google Cloud Platform to design, build, and deploy next-generation AI solutions, including cutting-edge agentic systems. If you're passionate about solving complex problems and building the future of AI on the cloud, we want to hear from you.
Responsibility
Design & Build on GCP: Architect, develop, and deploy scalable AI and Machine Learning applications specifically on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Lead Agentic AI R&D: Spearhead research and development of sophisticated AI agent applications and multi-agent systems, leveraging GCP's AI infrastructure.
End-to-End Model Management: Build, train, and manage the complete lifecycle of ML models using Vertex AI (Pipelines, Training, Endpoints), BigQuery ML, and TensorFlow.
Implement MLOps: Design and maintain robust MLOps pipelines on Vertex AI for continuous integration, training, and deployment (CI/CD/CT).
Collaborate & Innovate: Work closely with our Data, BI, and Business teams to translate complex needs into tangible, high-impact technical solutions.
Customer-Facing Solutions: Engage directly with customers to understand requirements, demonstrate capabilities, and deliver powerful AI solutions.
Stay Ahead of the Curve: Continuously explore and apply the latest advancements in GenAI, Google Cloud services, and Big Data technologies.
yeu_cau:
Requirement 
Must have 
Experience: 3+ years of professional experience in a similar Machine Learning or AI Engineering role.
Strong CS Fundamentals: A solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, computability, and complexity.
Python Proficiency: Proven programming skills, with a strong preference for Python.
Full ML Lifecycle Knowledge: A deep understanding of the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle, from data sourcing to model monitoring.
GenAI & Agent Expertise: Demonstrable knowledge and skills in Generative AI, AI agents, and agentic frameworks.
ML Toolkit: Hands-on experience with core ML libraries like TensorFlow, scikit-learn, OpenCV, etc.
Core Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving abilities, a strong teamwork spirit, and clear communication skills.
Business Acumen: Ability to dedicate time to client-facing activities, including pitching solutions and supporting new business generation.
Good English Skills: Fluency to collaborate in a multi-lingual environment and read technical documentation.
Nice to have 
Direct GCP AI Experience: Proven experience with Google Cloud's AI portfolio, especially Vertex AI (Pipelines, Endpoints, Search, Agent Builder) and BigQuery ML.
Experience with Gemini: Familiarity with integrating and fine-tuning Gemini models via the API.
Cloud-Native MLOps: Demonstrable experience building and managing MLOps workflows specifically on GCP.
Broader GCP Knowledge: Familiarity with related services like Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, and GKE.
Benefits
Competitive salary
13th-month salary bonus based on company performance.
Holiday and Tet bonuses.
Annual health check-up.
Laptop provided upon official employment.
12 paid leave days per year.
Public holidays according to Vietnamese law.
Clear career growth opportunities.
Annual company trip and regular team-building events.
